messages:
maria: Starting a scheduled dry run: shifting a subset of LAX GPU traffic -> AMS to validate the traffic-shift automation and cold-start behavior. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m stabilization windows. will kick off in ~5m. @jamal @alex please watch KPIs :eyes:
jamal: ack. i'll watch p99 latency, batch sizes, and queue depth. will flag if any warm-pool starves.
alex: +1. keep an eye on KV cache hit rate and prefix cache warmup logs. if we see >30% cold token penalty we should rollback.
sean: FYI watch egress cost metrics — AMS egress to customers spikes can blow the dry-run cost. @irene will need a heads up.
irene: noted. set an alert if estimated egress cost delta > $2k/hr for the test window.
ops-bot: Deploy step recorded: traffic-shift-controller v2.1.4 triggered by maria at 1765123456. dry-run mode enabled.
maria: kicking 10% now. health-check threshold: 99.5% success, p99 < 400ms, error-rate < 0.5%.
jamal: seeing a small bump in p99 from 320ms -> 360ms across the AMS nodes, but within threshold. queue depth +12%.
alex: cache-miss rate jumped to 18% initially, cache warmup progressing. patching auto-warm to prepopulate top prefixes on new nodes. command I used: ```curl -X POST https://ops-api/internal/warm -d '{"prefixes": ["/chat/","/embed/"]}'```
maria: 50% -> shifting in 8m if no regressions.
jamal: alert: instance S-ams-42 returned intermittent OOM-kill at 1765123780 during a 6s spike. it recovered and auto-restarted. logs: "OOMKilled — kernel: out-of-memory: Killed process 4312 (runtime)".
alex: looked at container logs — batch scheduler spiked due to an unexpected long-running rtx job. isolating that task. moving it to dedicated pool.
sean: because of the restart we saw a short flurry of fallback to older model variant, causing a small quality blip. we should update our failover tag to prefer same-quantization family to avoid RK differences.
ops-bot: Metric alert: estimated dry-run egress cost delta = $2,400/hr at 50% traffic, triggered at 1765124100.
irene: hitting the threshold. please throttle shift or reduce bandwidth - otherwise i'll pause the run.
maria: pausing at 50% now. rolling back the controller to 10% to contain costs and investigate OOM root cause.
jamal: action item: add pre-check to ensure node memory headroom > 20% before shifting. also add detector for persistent OOM within 30m window to auto-suspend shift.
alex: action item: implement prefix prewarm API call in traffic-shift-controller so new AMS nodes get hot keys before traffic ramps. also add preferred-variant label to failover policy.
sean: action item: update routing docs to include egress cost estimate per region and quick throttle command: ```opsctl shift --to ams --pct 10 --max-egress 1500```
irene: action item: add a cost-override grace for dry-runs up to $5k with finance notification; otherwise auto-pause.
maria: doc updates needed: 1) pre-shift checklist (memory headroom check, egress estimate, cache prewarm step) 2) suspend rules (OOM detector, cost threshold) 3) failover variant hygiene (prefer same-quant family) 4) runbook snippet with opsctl commands. i'll draft and ping for review.
jamal: small note: make the OOM detector tolerant of one restart if within a 2m window (k8s flapping), but suspend on >1 within 15m.
alex: i'll open a PR with controller changes and tests. tagging it "traffic-shift-prewarm-and-failover-filters".
sean: please also add a short play-execution checklist for devs running dry-runs: expected KPIs, contact list, and rollback commands. keep it < 1 page.
maria: agreed. timeline: PRs by EOD, doc draft tomorrow morning, re-run dry-run (limited to 20%) after fixes mid-next-week.
ops-bot: Incident note created: "LAX->AMS dry-run: pause at 50% due to OOM & egress cost" id=INC-176512.
irene: thanks all. mark this as cost-impacting and coordinate on the finance follow-up.
maria: thanks team. closing thread for now. will update when PRs land and we schedule the next window. :white_check_mark:
